```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  echo = FALSE,
  warning = FALSE,
  message = FALSE,
  fig.align = "center",
  dpi = 300
)

knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = here::here())

if (!require("pacman")) install.packages("pacman")
pacman::p_load(
  here, ggplot2, dplyr, scales, cowplot
)

theme_set(theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"),
    legend.position = "bottom",
    axis.title = element_text(size = 10),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 9)
  )
)
```

```{r load-data, include=FALSE}
suppressMessages(suppressWarnings({
  source(here("scripts/R/analysis/02_setup_and_global_variables.R"))
}))

# Load PSA caches for all three models
psa_files <- list(
  A = here("data", "tidy", "psa_obj_joint.rds"),
  B = here("data", "tidy", "psa_obj_focused.rds"),
  C = here("data", "tidy", "psa_obj_separate.rds")
)

psa_objs <- list()
for (model_name in names(psa_files)) {
  if (file.exists(psa_files[[model_name]])) {
    psa_objs[[model_name]] <- readRDS(psa_files[[model_name]])
    cat("Loaded PSA cache for Model", model_name, "\n")
  } else {
    cat("Missing PSA cache for Model", model_name, "\n")
  }
}
```

```{r build-scatter-data, include=FALSE}
strategy_labels <- c(
  "crp" = "CRP Strategy",
  "tlr" = "TLR Strategy",
  "tmb_braf" = "TMB/BRAF Strategy"
)

strategy_colors <- c(
  "CRP Strategy" = "#E69F00",
  "TLR Strategy" = "#009E73",
  "TMB/BRAF Strategy" = "#0072B2"
)

model_labels <- c(A = "Model A (Joint)", B = "Model B (Focused)", C = "Model C (Separate)")

scatter_all <- data.frame()

for (model_name in names(psa_objs)) {
  psa_obj <- psa_objs[[model_name]]
  cost_df <- as.data.frame(psa_obj$cost)
  effect_df <- as.data.frame(psa_obj$effect)

  for (strategy in setdiff(psa_obj$strategies, "control")) {
    if (!strategy %in% names(cost_df)) next

    inc_df <- data.frame(
      inc_effect = effect_df[[strategy]] - effect_df[["control"]],
      inc_cost = cost_df[[strategy]] - cost_df[["control"]],
      Strategy = strategy_labels[strategy],
      Model = model_labels[model_name],
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
    scatter_all <- rbind(scatter_all, inc_df)
  }
}

scatter_all$Strategy <- factor(scatter_all$Strategy, levels = strategy_labels)
scatter_all$Model <- factor(scatter_all$Model, levels = model_labels)

cat("Scatter data:", nrow(scatter_all), "points\n")
```

```{r create-ce-planes, fig.width=14, fig.height=5}
if (nrow(scatter_all) > 0) {
  p_planes <- ggplot(scatter_all, aes(x = inc_effect, y = inc_cost, color = Strategy)) +
    geom_point(alpha = 0.15, size = 0.3) +
    facet_wrap(~Model, ncol = 3, scales = "free") +
    geom_abline(intercept = 0, slope = WTP, linetype = "dashed",
                color = "black", linewidth = 0.5) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, color = "gray70", linewidth = 0.3) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 0, color = "gray70", linewidth = 0.3) +
    scale_y_continuous(
      labels = scales::label_currency(prefix = "\u20AC", big.mark = ",")
    ) +
    scale_x_continuous(
      labels = scales::number_format(accuracy = 0.01)
    ) +
    scale_color_manual(values = strategy_colors, name = "Strategy") +
    labs(
      x = "Incremental Effectiveness (QALYs)",
      y = "Incremental Cost (EUR)"
    ) +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(
      strip.text = element_text(size = 11, face = "bold"),
      legend.position = "bottom",
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
    ) +
    guides(color = guide_legend(override.aes = list(alpha = 1, size = 3), nrow = 1))

  print(p_planes)
}
```

```{r save-figure, include=FALSE}
if (nrow(scatter_all) > 0) {
  figs_dir <- here("figs")
  if (!dir.exists(figs_dir)) {
    dir.create(figs_dir, recursive = TRUE)
  }

  ggsave(
    filename = here("figs", "figure_s3.png"),
    plot = p_planes,
    width = 14,
    height = 5,
    dpi = 300,
    bg = "white"
  )

  cat("Figure saved to:", here("figs", "figure_s3.png"), "\n")
}
```
